scope: event-only SingleShotPose interface/training pilot on generic shared Genesis cuboid; not an E-POSE class/CAD evaluation

upstream_model.initialization: random paired initialization; LINEMOD weights are not used

input.source: raw events from the paired EventGenesis or V2E stream

labels.source: shared Genesis target pose, camera pose, actual camera K, and configured box dimensions
labels.single_shot_pose_format: class, projected centroid, eight projected 3D cuboid corners, normalized x/y extent

training.loss: pinned SingleShotPose RegionLoss coordinate pretraining phase
